systems.name: Kansas Public Employees Retirement System

statute.quote: There is hereby created the "Kansas public employees retirement system" which shall be a body corporate and an instrumentality of the state of Kansas.

body.name: Board of trustees of the Kansas public employees retirement system

source.quote: The board of trustees shall be responsible for the general administration of the system, subject to the provisions of this act.

website_source.quote: KPERS administers three statewide pension plans for Kansas state and local public employees.

covers_local_source.quote: An eligible employer may join the system on January 1 of any year. Application for affiliation shall be in the form of a resolution approved by the governing or legislative body of the eligible employer

systems.notes: One Census unit; KPERS administers the KPERS plan (state, school and local employees), KP&F (police and firemen) and the judges' plan. Old domain kpers.org redirects to kspers.gov.
